messages.content: Plan from the robot's forward-facing camera: image left/right are robot left/right; centered is straight ahead. Translation steps are 0.25 m; turns are 30 degrees in place. Later actions use the heading after earlier turns. Return the complete ordered plan using at most 4 actions, only tool calls, no explanation. Use as few actions as needed. This is an unexecuted mock plan.
Rotate left in place, then translate forward one step. Include both actions in this response.

function.description: Rotate in place toward the given side.
